title: Which Pawn Takes Back
setup: Black's knight has just taken yours, and two of your pawns can take it back. Either way you end up with two pawns on one file.
hint: Both captures stack your c-pawns. Which one also leaves a pawn with no neighbor at all?
explanation:
## The Idea

Either capture doubles your c-pawns, so count what else each one costs.

{{bxc3}} also strands the a-pawn with no pawn beside it: an isolated pawn, for nothing.

{{dxc3}} keeps every other pawn joined to a neighbor, opens the d-file toward Black's queen, and clears the road from c1 to h6 for your bishop. Capturing away from the center is right here because of what it opens.
